summary: Created a 6-phase implementation plan for the in-dispatch phase-commit staging surface, integrating the research ruling that --task alone is structurally incapable of catching an undeclared path (the contention manifest requires two or more declaring tasks). The plan lands both mechanisms within file_scope: --task at all 21 invocation sites plus a canonical pre-commit Containment self-check authored once in the core definition and pointed at from the other fourteen. It exercises the pre-fix regression case live in a throwaway repo, audits uniformity mechanically across all fifteen definitions, and records the git-commit-scoped.sh chokepoint as a constrained follow-up without widening file_scope.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: live pre-fix regression evidence, canonical self-check plus --task in the core definition, uniform wiring across the remaining fourteen in two parallel phases, mechanical uniformity audit with the git-commit-scoped.sh follow-up record, and a full verify-deploy gate.
